### Read the Bible: Leviticus 6, Psalms 5-6, Proverbs 21, Colossians 4
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-6-psalms-5-6-proverbs-21-colossians-4/
Passage: Leviticus 6:1-7
Points:
- Sins like theft, deception, and false swearing against neighbors are intentional wrongs for which God still provides atonement.
- These common intentional sins arising from temptation or resentment differ from brazen, "high-handed" defiance against God.
- True repentance requires practical restitution in full, plus an additional twenty percent paid to the victim.
- Wrongs done to another person are treated first and foremost as unfaithfulness against the Lord.
- The offender must both make amends with the victim and seek God's pardon through the prescribed guilt offering.
